tiling_weathered.name: The same pattern, then time
tiling_weathered.description: The tiling hall's black and white raster returns twice, side by side: once as Tutorial_Tiling_Floor shows it, once through wallpaper_tile.gdshader with the Pattern Studio's aging layers on sliders - dirt, wear, dust, sun fade, cracks, chips. The rule, the motif's turn and the exception are the tiling desk's own; the shader adds only time. Map-token keys: rule, turn, exception, dirt, wear, dust, fade, cracks, chips (0-1); config_mode walls stands both surfaces up.
tiling_weathered.qfep_connection: A rule makes the same surface at every address; weathering is what the surface has answered to since. The joints, the corners and the exposed faces age first: the pattern's own structure decides where time collects.
interactions: RULE cycles the six tiling relations; TURN MOTIF and EXCEPTION are the tiling desk's controls.
DIRT, WEAR, DUST, SUN FADE, CRACKS, CHIPS slide one aging layer each over the right-hand surface; the left stays clean for comparison.
CLEAN returns the aged surface to the pattern.
Grout, wear and dust act on the raster's 8 x 8 joints (cell_count), not only on the surface edge.
